issue: Canonical Terrain50 ingestion accepts .txt as a grid member although official OS Terrain50 grid supply identifies the raster grid as .asc, and it does not assert the official nearest-0.1m raw value lattice before sampling.
required_patch: Restrict official raw Terrain50 sampled grid members to .asc.
Do not promote .txt as official Terrain50 raster input.
Read and hash the raw ASCII header before Rasterio interpretation.
Assert ncols=200, nrows=200, cellsize=50 and exact named-tile south-west origin; cross-check against Rasterio dimensions/transform/bounds.
Bind accepted ASC SHA-256 to selected official archive SHA-256 and required 10km tile ID.
Exclude NoData first, then verify all valid raw elevation cells lie on the documented 0.1m lattice within strict parsing tolerance.
Publish official_asc_identity_verified, raw_header_sha256, archive_sha256, tile_id and decimetre_lattice_verified.
Accuracy screening must fail closed unless official_asc_identity_verified=true and decimetre_lattice_verified=true.
reason: publisher-safe child staging does not mutate canonical automation paths
